Summary: Reserve an EV charging bay during service
Description: As an EV owner booking a dealer service appointment, I want to reserve a charging bay during the appointment so that my car is charged when I pick it up. Acceptance criteria: (1) Option shown only for vehicle type EV. (2) 2 charging bays per hour, separate from the 4 service bays. (3) GET /api/slots adds evChargingAvailable and evChargingRemaining to each slot for EV. (4) POST /api/bookings accepts evCharging: true and returns 409 when no charging bay is left. (5) Each slot shows chargers left; confirmation mentions the charging bay. (6) Unit tests cover the new rules and existing tests pass. Design: Figma frame 'Booking – EV charging bay'.

Summary: Show estimated service duration on the confirmation
Description: After booking, show the estimated duration of the selected service (from the service catalogue) in the confirmation message.
Add DELETE /api/bookings/:id. Cancelling frees the service bay for that hour. Return 404 for unknown ids.
POST /api/bookings accepts dates in the past. It should return 400 with a clear message. Add a test.
Dealers are open 08:00-12:00 on Saturdays. GET /api/slots should return only morning slots on Saturdays.

Summary: Booking page is hard to use on mobile
Description: On screens under 480px the two-column form overflows. Stack the fields in one column on small screens.

Summary: Add a winter tire change service
Description: Add 'Winter tire change' (50 min, all vehicle types) to the service catalogue.
Limit POST /api/bookings to 10 requests per minute per IP to reduce abuse. Return 429 when exceeded.
